contentText:
The unique translucent design of the Nothing Headphone 1 | Photo by Owen Grove / The Verge

There’s no denying that Nothing knows how to make eye-catching headphones. If you’re considering a new pair of over-ear cans, the Nothing Headphone 1 pack style and great sound, and they’re on sale for $189 at Amazon . That’s a big discount considering the usual price drifts between $240 and $299.

Nothing Headphone 1

Nothing’s first pair of over-ear headphones feature a retro transparent design and high-end features like active noise cancellation, spatial audio with head tracking, and plush ear pads. They also feature a paddle button that allows you to control music playback. Read our review .

Where to Buy:

- $299 $189 at Amazon

In addition to the unique design, these headphones sport features you’d expect to find in more expensive flagship offerings, like spatial audio and active noise cancellation. There are some odd omissions, like a lack of multipoint pairing, and the 3.5mm analog port only works when the headphones are charged.

Read our Nothing Headphone 1 review .
